You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact is one line: subject | relation | value | condition (after "if:", when there is one) | the place it
comes from. A long value or condition is shortened and ends with "…"; a normal form (a date, a duration, a short
name) follows the value in brackets when there is one. Some facts carry a note computed from the dates: trust the notes.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the facts, one by one, before you answer.
  A repeal, a limit or an application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a
  date is still fully in force, with everything it permits, on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does
  not yet bind on earlier days.
- If a note says that a date quoted in a condition was corrected, reason with the corrected date.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the
  facts, one item per fact. Facts filed under the same article, annex part or numbered point belong together.
  When the answer is a group named by an article or an annex part and the facts list the members of that group,
  give the members, not the name of the group.
- A fact noted as "filed under a place the question names" belongs to the answer of a "which / what" question
  about that place whenever its relation fits the question: list all of them, not one.
- Lines under "Computed by rule" are results worked out in code from the numbered facts they name: trust them,
  give their result as the answer for the device asked about, and put the fact numbers they name in "used".
- Include only what the question asks for: no neighbouring item, no other regime that the question did not ask
  about. An option that combines several things in sequence is one item, not several.
- A fact about a neighbouring subject (another paragraph, another device, another kind of verification, another
  product, another deadline) does not answer the question. When the exact subject asked about is absent from the
  facts, "unknown" is the correct answer: do not answer from the nearest fact.
- For a "who" question, when one fact, or several facts with the same subject and relation, name several bodies,
  all of them are the answer together: name each one.
- For "which categories / which items listed in a place", the answer is the members filed under that place, each
  in the words of its fact, without adding the place to the item.
- For "which risks / which hazards does a numbered point address", use every fact filed under that point whatever
  its relation: a measure is required against a risk, and its subject and condition name that risk.
- Never return a list for a "text" answer: a question that one sentence answers (who, why, how, under which
  condition, which one thing and why) gets one short sentence. "Which / what / list all" of several things is "set".
- Facts marked "matched by relation" were found by querying the facts by their relation, subject and place:
  prefer them. When the question asks for all of something, the answer is the list of their subjects or values,
  one item per fact, nothing merged and nothing dropped. If the matched facts answer the question, do not add
  items from the other facts, which are context.
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "for how long" alone is "duration";
  "can / may / is / does" is "boolean"; "which / what (several things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition,
  or who does something and within what time is "text", and the text names every element asked for.
- Return JSON only, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "the facts and dates compared, step by step, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Following a substantial modification of machinery, which party is regarded as its manufacturer?

Facts:
[0] non-professional user modifying machinery for own use | becomes manufacturer | shall not be considered to be a manufacturer | if: for his or her own use | [REG, Art. 18] [matched by relation]
[1] manufacturer | becomes manufacturer | markets those products under its name or trademark | if: manufactures products within the scope of this Regulation or who has those products designed or manufactured | [REG, Art. 3(18)] [matched by relation]
[2] manufacturer | becomes manufacturer | puts those products into service for its own use | if: manufactures products within the scope of this Regulation | [REG, Art. 3(18)] [matched by relation]
[3] substantial modification | defined as | a modification of machinery or a related product | if: which is not foreseen or planned by the manufacturer | [REG, Art. 3(16)]
[4] natural or legal person carrying out substantial modification | has obligation | shall be subject to the obligations of the manufacturer set out in… | if: if the substantial modification has an impact on the safety of only machinery or a related product that is part of an assembly of… | [REG, Art. 18]
[5] verifica impianti di riscaldamento | requires check after | a seguito di modifica importante (modifica importante) | [inail-guide, p. 10]
[6] person who carries out substantial modification | has obligation | ensure and declare on its sole responsibility | [REG, Art. 18]
[7] manufacturer | has obligation | shall apply one of the following procedures | if: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A | [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[8] manufacturer or his authorised representative | has obligation | shall apply one of the following procedures | if: Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2)… | [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
[9] manufacturer or his authorised representative | has obligation | shall apply one of the following procedures | if: Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and has not been manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article… | [DIR, Art. 12(4)]
[10] manufacturer | has obligation | the limits of the safety functions are to be established as part… | if: where such modifications could lead to hazardous situations | [REG, Annex III, 1.2.1]
[11] costruttore di un macchinario | has obligation | fornire in formato cartaceo le istruzioni per l'uso sicuro | [univpm-guideline, p. 7]
[12] datore di lavoro (punti 1 e 2) | has obligation | si ritengono assolti con la procedura omologativa | if: Per le attrezzature sopra elencate, prive di marcatura CE8 e non oggetto di mo- difiche sostanziali | [inail-guide, p. 35]
[13] machinery, software installed on it (1.1.9) | requires measure | collect evidence of a legitimate or illegitimate intervention | if: intervention in the software or a modification of the software or its configuration | [REG, Annex III, 1.1.9]
[14] ispezione e controllo degli armadi ventilati e delle unità ventilanti | requires check after | a seguito di mal funzionamento | [unict-guideline, p. 15]
[15] impianti di messa a terra | requires check after | variazioni della categoria dell’impianto e la modifica della destinazione d’uso con applicazione… | [inail-guide, p. 15]
[16] manufacturer | has obligation | shall apply the following principles, in the order given | [REG, Annex III, 1.1.2]
[17] relevant economic operator | has obligation | to put an end to the non-compliance concerned | if: where a Member State makes one of the following findings with regard to machinery or a related product | [REG, Art. 46(1)]
[18] relevant economic operator | has obligation | put an end to the non-compliance concerned | if: Without prejudice to Article 43, where a Member State makes one of the following findings with regard to partly completed machinery | [REG, Art. 46(2)]
[19] locomotives and brake-vans | listed in | locomotives and brake-vans (annex I, part B, point 12.1) | if: Machinery for underground working of the following types: | [REG, Annex I, Part B, point 12]
[20] hydraulic-powered roof supports | listed in | hydraulic-powered roof supports (annex I, part B, point 12.2) | if: Machinery for underground working of the following types: | [REG, Annex I, Part B, point 12]
[21] machinery or related product emergency stop | requires measure | one or more emergency stop devices | if: The following exceptions apply | [REG, Annex III, 1.2.4.3]
[22] declaration of incorporation of partly completed machinery | has obligation | must contain the following particulars | [DIR, Annex II, 1]
[23] fabbricante ovvero soggetti della catena della distribuzione | has obligation | dall'organo di vigilanza territorialmente competente | if: qualora, alla conclusione dell'accertamento tecnico effettuato dall'autorità nazionale per la sorveglianza del mercato, risulti la non conformità dell'attrezzatura | [DLGS70, art. 70, c. 4]
[24] datore di lavoro, interventi di controllo periodici | has obligation | interventi di controllo periodici | if: secondo frequenze stabilite in base alle indicazioni fornite dai fabbricanti, ovvero dalle norme di buona tecnica | [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 8]
[25] manutenzione delle attrezzature di lavoro | maintenance rule | sulla base delle prescrizioni del fabbricante | [unict-guideline, p. 1]
[26] ponte sollevatore per veicoli | has declaration | dichiarazione di conformità al prototipo | if: purché venga appurato dallo stesso fabbricante che l’esemplare sia in tutto identico a quello riconosciuto idoneo o vengano apportate le modifiche necessarie a renderlo… | [inail-guide, p. 43]
[27] fabbricante di ponti sollevatori per veicoli | has obligation | provvederà poi a rilasciare a tutti gli utenti un certificato di conformità… | if: Nel primo caso | [inail-guide, p. 44]
[28] modifications to the settings or rules of control systems | requires measure | shall be prevented | if: where such modifications could lead to hazardous situations | [REG, Annex III, 1.2.1]
[29] commissioning tests | requires check after | making any modifications | if: for the first time | [ur5e-manual, p. 198]
[30] thorough check of safety functions | requires check after | commissioning and modifications | [nanoscan3-manual, p. 105]
[31] verifica periodica | verified by | soggetto abilitato | [inail-guide, p. 13]
[32] prima verifica periodica | verified by | personale dell’Inail ovvero su incarico dell’Inail dal soggetto abilitato indicato dal datore… | [inail-guide, p. 29]
[33] prima verifica periodica | verified by | personale dell’Inail | if: su incarico dell’Inail dal soggetto abilitato indicato dal datore di lavoro nella richiesta | [inail-guide, p. 36]
[34] prima verifica periodica | verified by | soggetto abilitato indicato dal datore di lavoro | if: se la prima verifica periodica viene eseguita dal soggetto abilitato indicato dal datore di lavoro nella richiesta e delegato dall’Inail | [inail-guide, p. 38]
[35] richiesta di verifica periodica | verified by | un soggetto pubblico o privato abilitato | if: Laddove trascorrano inutilmente i 45 giorni dalla richiesta completa | [inail-guide, p. 38]
[36] prima verifica periodica | verified by | soggetto abilitato indicato dal datore di lavoro | if: su incarico dell’Inail | [inail-guide, p. 40]
[37] prima verifica periodica | verified by | soggetto abilitato indicato dal datore di lavoro | if: delegato dall’Inail | [inail-guide, p. 41]
[38] verifica periodica | verified by | soggetto pubblico o privato abilitato | if: Laddove trascorrano inutilmente i 45 giorni dalla richiesta completa | [inail-guide, p. 42]
[39] soggetto abilitato | has obligation | si impegna al rispetto dei termini temporali | [DM2011, art. 2, c. 2]
[40] datore di lavoro | has obligation | comunica al soggetto titolare della funzione il nominativo | if: Nell'ipotesi di cui all'articolo 2, comma 8 | [DM2011, art. 3]
[41] soggetto abilitato incaricato dal datore di lavoro | has obligation | corrisponde all'INAIL | if: Nell'ipotesi di cui all'articolo 2, comma 8 | [DM2011, art. 3]
[42] economic operators | has obligation | shall, on request, identify the following to the market surveillance authorities | if: on request | [REG, Art. 19(1)]
[43] decision to revoke delegation | applies from | the day following the publication | if: or at a later date specified therein | [REG, Art. 47(3)]
[44] lifting accessories | must accompany | instructions setting out at least the following particulars | if: each lifting accessory or each commercially indivisible batch of lifting accessories | [REG, Annex III, 4.4.1]
[45] technical documentation | has obligation | shall include at least the following elements | [REG, Annex IV, Part A]
[46] This Directive | applies from | 20th day following its publication | [DIR, Art. 28]
[47] emergency stop, numbered requirement 1.2.4.3 | requires measure | emergency stop devices | if: The following exceptions apply | [DIR, Annex I, 1.2.4.3]
[48] EC declaration of conformity | has obligation | must contain the following particulars | [DIR, Annex II, 1]
[49] Regulation | applies from | 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) | if: However, the following Articles shall apply from the following dates | [CORR, Corrigendum, point 10]
[50] integrator designing and installing a robot application | integrator responsible for | Observe the following warnings for all the interface groups | if: including when you design and install an application | [ur5e-manual, p. 63]
[51] integrator designing and installing an application | integrator responsible for | Observe the following warnings for all the interface groups | if: including when you design and install an application | [ur10e-manual, p. 64]
[52] user | integrator responsible for | set the following in accordance with the risk assessment | [ur10e-manual, p. 120]
[53] non-professional user modifying machinery for own use | has obligation | shall not be subject to the obligations on the manufacturer set out… | if: for his or her own use | [REG, Art. 18]
[54] Datore di Lavoro/RDRL | has obligation | deve mettere a disposizione dei lavoratori le informazioni ed istruzioni d’uso | if: anche per le attrezzature antecedenti all’emanazione della Direttiva Macchine | [univpm-guideline, p. 7]
[55] atti convenzionali per attrezzature in uso presso terzi | has obligation | devono indicare a chi spettano gli obblighi previsti dal D. Lgs. 81/08… | [univpm-guideline, p. 7]
[56] datore di lavoro | has obligation | comunicazione di messa in servizio all’Unità operativa territoriale dell’Inail competente | [inail-guide, p. 35]
[57] datore di lavoro | has obligation | richiesta di prima verifica periodica all’Unità operativa territoriale dell’Inail competente | [inail-guide, p. 35]
[58] datore di lavoro | has obligation | richiesta di verifica periodica successiva | [inail-guide, p. 35]
[59] UNIVPM equipment guideline, Art. 10(7): manufacturer's duty to provide safety information on paper for machinery usable by non-professional users | has obligation | the manufacturer shall provide, in paper format… | if: In the case of machinery or a related product intended for non-professional users or that can, under reasonably foreseeable conditions, be used by non-professional users… | [REG, Art. 10(7)]
[60] datore di lavoro | has obligation | provvedere affinché tali attrezzature siano oggetto di idonea manutenzione | [unict-guideline, p. 1]
[61] Lifting device at list position 6 of the igea-equipment list, located in Lula (Sos Enattos mine) | device kind | GRU IDRAULICA CA FASSI IVECO AP 337 (hydraulic crane (Fassi Iveco AP 337)) | if: Lula (Sos Enattos) | [igea-equipment, p. 9]
[62] Equipment list entry at position 23: Euro costruzioni Pellegrini crane, matr. 459, built 1989 | device kind | GRU (crane (lifting device)) | if: A Lula (Sos Enattos) | [igea-equipment, p. 9]
[63] Periodic verification (after the first) of Igea S.p.A. lifting equipment (apparecchi di sollevamento), under the D.M. 11 aprile 2011 | verified by | da parte di soggetti abilitati pubblici o privati (authorised public or private bodies) | if: con le modalità del D.M. 11 aprile 2011 | [igea-equipment, p. 3]
[64] IGEA device 1 | device kind | GRU IDRAULICA (gru idraulica per autocarro) | [igea-equipment, p. 6]

The matched facts come from both the Directive and the Regulation: use the Regulation's and name that act in the sentence. The other act's facts on the relations asked were left out; today's date does not change which act the question is about.

{"reasoning": "Fact 6 says the person who carries out a substantial modification must ensure compliance and declare it on its sole responsibility (REG, Art. 18). Fact 4 says that person is subject to the manufacturer's obligations, under a condition about the modification's impact on safety. Fact 0 excludes a non-professional who modifies machinery for their own use from being regarded as a manufacturer. The question is not date-dependent, so the dates do not change the answer.",
"kind": "text",
"value": "The natural or legal person who carries out the substantial modification is regarded as the manufacturer and takes on the manufacturer's obligations, except a non-professional who modifies machinery for his or her own use.",
"text": "Under Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, Article 18, the natural or legal person who carries out a substantial modification is treated as the manufacturer and must ensure compliance and declare it on its sole responsibility. A non-professional modifying machinery for his or her own use is not considered a manufacturer.",
"used": [0, 4, 6]}
